title: Composio Project API key (ak_): one-property twin (boundary)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is cut, extended or delimited so that it no longer ends where the format ends. Legacy mutation notes: boundary: an identifier byte glued after the body, so the key is embedded in a longer run, boundary: cak_ (an agent key of unknown shape) with the same body; ak_ is glued to c, and boundary: x glued before ak_. Twin of "Composio Project API key (ak_): must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of composio-api-key-bare-prose: boundary: cak_ (an agent key of unknown shape) with the same body; ak_ is glued to c. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
